summary: Plan scope, schedules, costs and project controls in five practical days. Explore the course and build useful delivery records.
lede: Project management training helps coordinators, team leads and new project managers turn a brief into a workable plan and track delivery. Learners practise defining scope, breaking deliverables into a work breakdown structure and sequencing activities using critical path basics, then maintaining risk and change records and preparing status reports.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who contribute to, coordinate or oversee defined projects and need to turn assigned work into a clear plan, track decisions and report progress.
prerequisites: No prior project-management qualification is required. Familiarity with routine workplace assignments and the ability to read a brief, discuss responsibilities and work with basic project information will help you complete the exercises.
